summary: Reviewed and corrected the initial-contact boundary before release: a first-positive-root rule omitted touching launches with nonupward velocity.

payload.method: Direct Python evaluation of the authored analytic contact classification and descending-root equation; no scene implementation executed.
payload.observed_result: Negative clearance rejected. With g=10, c=0 and vy=0 or -5 contact is t=0; c=0,vy=5 returns at t=1; c=10,vy=-5 impacts at t=1. Descending-root residual checks passed for touching-upward and elevated upward/downward cases.
payload.tolerance: Absolute quadratic residual <1e-12 for the declared small numerical examples; exact expected boundary times.
payload.regime: Pre-release revision-1 authoring correction and analytic boundary verification only. No browser, runtime collider or general numerical-stability certification.
